Prince William Visits Dharma Productions, Meets Bollywood Stars

Prince William visited Dharma Productions' office in Mumbai, where he met with Karan Johar, Saif Ali Khan, and Kareena Kapoor. A special dance performance featured the song 'Bole Chudiyan'. Karan Johar stated that the Prince promised to watch the film 'Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham'.
